answer: Replaying a stored transcript fails since the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a beacon spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a wander header. Producing 46 answers an epoch therefore costs 72 real forward passes, and the mesa record lets any auditor recompute the check. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
